program_name: Diploma in Medical and Health Science

fees.notes: International total payable fee for the entire programme per UOC official International Fees Structure (includes registration RM2,000, processing RM1,500, administration RM8,000/RM5,000 ODL, EMGS RM2,800 and resource fees); per-year amount not published. Source: https://cyberjaya.edu.my/admission/fees/international-fees-structure (fetched 2026-09-18)

requirements.general: Any of these: SPM: Pass with a minimum of 5 credits in the following subjects: Bahasa Malaysia Science subjects: Biology or Chemistry; OR Physics with a pass in Biology; OR General Science / Applied Science Mathematics or Additional Mathematics 2 (two) other subjects AND pass in English STPM: Pass with a Grade C (GPA 2.00) in one subject AND a minimum of 3 credits in the following subjects: Science Subjects: Biology or Chemistry; OR Physics with a pass in Biology; OR General Science Mathematics or Additional Mathematics UEC: Pass with minimum Grade B in 3 subjects: Science subjects: Biology or Chemistry; OR Physics with a pass in Biology; OR Mathematics / Advanced Mathematics General Science O-Level/IGCSE: Pass with a minimum of 5 credits in the following subjects: Two (2) credits from Science or Mathematics subject (Biology/ Physics/Chemistry/General Science); Three (3) from any other subjects; AND Pass in English OR Candidates with other relevant qualifications are subject to approval by the MAB Certificate in health-related field: Certificate in a Health-related field recognised and approved by the MAB AND a minimum of 3 credits in the following subjects: Science subjects: Biology or Chemistry; OR Physics with a pass in Biology; OR General Science Mathematics or Additional Mathematics Additional Requirements: Medical Status - Students must be certified medically fit by a registered medical practitioner recognised by the University and free from: Mental illness Physical and sensory disability HIV-AIDS Hepatitis B and C Epilepsy Drug addiction and substance abuse Any other medical condition certified unfit English Proficiency (For International Students): English Proficiency for International Students: Minimum IELTS score of 4.0 or equivalent
